title: MatchEvent
description: Proposed contract pending team approval. JSON validation cannot guarantee that a reference identifies an existing original GOAL in the same match or that it has not already been annulled; these checks belong to match-state-service.

minute.description: Initial project simulation limit, not a universal football rule.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp using the RFC 3339 date-time profile. Validators must enable format assertion.

reference_event_id.description: For GOAL_ANNULLED, identifies the original GOAL event; existence is not checked by JSON Schema.
